settings.hero_subcopy: A small set of desk objects pressed from rescued wood — pen holders and organisers that keep a working surface calm. Made responsibly, kept for years.
settings.story_text: Rescued materials, named makers, and forms quiet enough to live on your desk. We choose every object against one standard — then let it earn its place.
settings.standard_lead: We don’t clutter the desk. We choose a few objects against one standard — what they’re made of, who made them, and whether they’ll still be here in ten years.
settings.proof1_body: Designed and pressed by a small workshop in France — short supply chains and named makers, not anonymous factories.
settings.proof2_body: Bio-composite wood: recycled European wood fibres bound with a corn-derived, plant-based polymer. Waste, given a second life.
settings.proof3_body: Solid, tactile forms that hold their shape and wipe clean. Objects you’ll refill and reuse, not replace.
settings.proof4_body: Recyclable, and made to be kept — objects you refill and reuse, not replace.
settings.companion_kicker: The other half of the desk
settings.companion_lead: An object earns its keep beside a good notebook. Start with paper worth writing on.
settings.trust_award: Pressed from bio-composite wood — recycled fibres and a plant-based binder, made in France.
settings.closing_text: Build a desk from a few things you’ll keep.
